title: SHUT UP
blurb: The SHUT UP clip — exasperation in its purest distilled form. Not angry, exactly; just completely, terminally done. It's the correct response to bad puns, unsolicited advice, and anyone explaining crypto at a party. Play it with love, play it with venom — the clip supports both readings and everything between. Universal, timeless, constantly necessary.
